Italian Truckers' Strike Disrupts Food and Fuel Deliveries

Truckers in Italy are protesting high gas prices, leading to disruptions in food and fuel deliveries across parts of the country, particularly in the south. The strike has resulted in empty shelves in stores and dry gas pumps. Production of goods like buffalo mozzarella has also been halted due to the delivery blockades.
